players.product: CIS color-filter / micro-lens optical foundry, expanding into silicon-photonics micro-optics: photodetectors for pluggable transceivers (entering mass production) and micro-lens arrays for FAU / PIC light coupling, with CPO development (TSMC holds 67.11%)

quarterly_data.signal: 1Q 2026 results (deck dated May 7, 2026, presented at Citi's 2026 Taiwan Tech Conference): net revenue NT$2,348 million, up 8.0% YoY and 2.6% QoQ; gross margin 32.2% (+7.7 ppts YoY); operating margin 22.8%; net profit NT$476 million; EPS NT$1.50 (+76.5% YoY). Revenue by product: image sensor (CIS) NT$1,843 million (+13.4% YoY), micro-optical elements NT$444 million (-9.5% YoY, +3.0% QoQ), others (mask, NRE and testing services) NT$61 million. By application: mobile +3.0% YoY, security +39.3%, automotive +8.8%. Capex NT$233 million; free cash flow NT$815 million.
